description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating Deepgram for speech-to-text, OpenAI LLM for responses, and TTS for speech output, with WebRTC transport and event handling.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Frame used to trigger LLM execution within the pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with parameters and state.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds context and conversation history for the LLM.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user and assistant aggregators.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments for runner configuration and control.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Parameters for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, setting up transport and starting the bot.
